description: R5 (spec line 22-23) forbids referencing/requiring 'any paid/keyed service env (TWITTERAPI_KEY, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CDP_*, any Dais cred)'. The R5 guard test (line 18) only matches the four literal strings TWITTERAPI_KEY|FIRECRAWL_API_KEY|OPENAI_API_KEY|CDP_API_KEY. It would NOT catch a reintroduction of, e.g., CDP_API_KEY_SECRET via process.env, a Dais wallet key (WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY), GOOGLE_LOGIN_*, or any other credential the spec's open-ended 'any Dais cred' clause covers. The static assertion is narrower than the invariant it claims to protect, so R5 is under-verified.
